India.text: Buddhism and Jainism both arose here, proclaiming social orders unlinked to heredity.
India.evidence: During this period, Buddhism and Jainism arose, proclaiming social orders unlinked to heredity.

China.text: About 17% of the world's population lives here.
China.evidence: It is the world's second-most populous country after India, with a population exceeding 1.4 billion (17% of the world's population).

United States.text: Independence was formally declared on July 2, 1776, two days before the Declaration of Independence.
United States.evidence: Independence from Great Britain was formally declared in the Lee Resolution of July 2, 1776, two days before the Declaration of Independence.

Indonesia.text: Home to hundreds of ethnic groups and more than 700 languages.
Indonesia.evidence: Indonesia has hundreds of ethnic groups and more than 700 languages, as well as diverse regional cultures.

Pakistan.text: It has the second-largest Muslim population in the world.
Pakistan.evidence: It is the fifth-most populous country, with a population of over 241.5 million, having the second-largest Muslim population in the world as of 2023.

Nigeria.text: The Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo together make up over 60% of the population.
Nigeria.evidence: The three largest ethnic groups are the Hausa, Yoruba, and Igbo together constituting over 60% of the total population.

Brazil.text: The only Portuguese-speaking country in the Americas, with the largest Lusophone population in the world.
Brazil.evidence: Brazil has the largest Lusophone population in the world and is the only Portuguese-speaking country in the Americas, where it is the official language.

Bangladesh.text: Before independence in 1971 it was East Pakistan, the eastern wing of Pakistan.
Bangladesh.evidence: After the partition of India in 1947, East Bengal became the eastern wing of the newly formed Dominion of Pakistan and was later renamed East Pakistan. ... Bangladesh became a sovereign nation on 16 December 1971.

Russia.text: Moscow, its capital, is the most populous metropolitan area in Europe.
Russia.evidence: Moscow, the most populous metropolitan area in Europe, is the capital and largest city of Russia, while Saint Petersburg is its second-largest city and a major cultural centre.

Mexico.text: Home to more native Spanish speakers than any other country.
Mexico.evidence: With a population around 131 million as of 2025, Mexico is the tenth-most populous country in the world and is home to the largest number of native Spanish speakers.
